overview: Asthma is a chronic lung disease affecting people of all ages, caused by inflammation and muscle tightening around the airways, which makes it harder to breathe. Symptoms can include coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath and chest tightness, and can be mild or severe. Asthma can be managed with the right treatment, allowing people to lead a normal, active life.
symptoms: wheezing when exhaling and sometimes when inhaling
chest tightness, making it difficult to breathe deeply
prevention: reducing exposure to environmental allergens and irritants
improving indoor and outdoor air quality
risk_factors: allergic conditions (such as eczema and rhinitis)
key_facts: Asthma affects an estimated 363 million people worldwide
Most asthma-related deaths occur in low- and lower-middle-income countries
Asthma is the most common chronic disease among children
